outcome: Perinatal pain (labor pain, Brief Pain Inventories, "pain right now" scores, maximum pain unpleasantness score experienced during labor, sensory dimensions of labor pain)
Depression (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Score, postpartum depression scores)
cohort: 183 pregnant women between 28-37 weeks' gestation were prospectively genotyped for single-nucleotide polymorphisms.
finding: Specific single-nucleotide polymorphisms (rs4633, rs1135349, and rs7548151) were found to be associated with certain perinatal pain measures, such as "pain right now" scores at six weeks postpartum and maximum pain unpleasantness during labor.
